audit_name: Day 22 Checkpoint 020 Lu Systematics and 136Nd Boundary Audit

163Lu.TSD2_n1: Rigorous confirmation: EUROBALL linear polarization directly selects large delta (~ -2.5 to -3.0), Qt ~ 10 eb measured by DSAM

TSD3_n2_476keV.status: Two roots remain mathematically compatible; n=2 two-phonon interpretation is conditional on large root adoption

165Lu.TSD2_n1: Measured DCO gives 92.3% E2 for adopted large branch (B(E2)_out/in ~ 0.16-0.17)
165Lu.TSD3_n2: Weak connecting links lack sufficient DCO statistics and have zero polarization; n=2 assignment is based on homology/systematics with 163Lu

TSD2_n1.adopted_method: Selected large negative delta by analogy with 163Lu (92-98% E2)
TSD2_n1.small_root_sensitivity: Small root collapse factor spans 8.6x to 197.5x across transitions

lu_systematics.regional_conclusion: Only 163Lu TSD2 (n_w=1) possesses independent linear polarization root selection; all n_w=2 claims and 167Lu depend on cross-isotope homology

nd136_audit.connecting_transitions: 4 known transitions (740, 751, 768, 785 keV); only 751 keV clean enough for P-Rac analysis

751keV_mixing_ratio.character: Overwhelmingly M1-dominated (81.27% M1), contrasting with odd-A wobblers

nd136_audit.model_normalization: PRM second-order E2 parameter (chi*beta2 = 2.14 * 0.185) and M1 parameter (g_eff/Q) are normalized to this single experimental point

dsam_lifetime_evidence.mechanism: Two-quasiproton s-band alignment and band crossing, which breaks pure collective wobbling symmetry

nd136_audit.protocol_status: Fails Gate 1 (18.7% E2 is M1-dominated) and Gate 2 (11x B(E2) collapse at crossing); single-point PRM calibration is descriptive, not predictive
